newsitem.title: USA: US Dec S&P 500 sets all time high, then ends lower.
newsitem.headline: US Dec S&P 500 sets all time high, then ends lower.

text.p: U.S. December Standard and Poor's 500 futures rushed to an all-time high at 718.70 early in sync with strength in the Dow, only to falter and end lower.
"It looked a little euphoric at the all-time high, like nobody wanted to miss the boat, then you saw a little bit of a pullback and a drift down," an S&P 500 futures trader said.
Weakening Nasdaq stocks and Treasury bond futures helped undermine the stock rally, the trader said.
"It was a little retracement, and well-needed, I might add," the trader said.

"We had followthrough strength early after technically they looked good on Friday and then they kind of slipped lower," another S&P 500 futures trader said. Once December slid below a 15-minute trendline at 715.80, profit-taking materialized, he added.
He said that traders eyed gyrations in IBM, and some squared positions before Microsoft quarterly earnings due later today.
"They're a little worried about those tech stocks, but as you can see, the S&P is really quite resilient," another trader said.
December S&P 500 futures closed down 1.45 points at 714.40, up from the session low of 711.80.
December Nasdaq 100 futures slid to the lowest price since early October, posting an outside day on daily bar charts with a lower close.
The Nasdaq largely followed IBM whose shares went on a rollercoaster ride today after earnings, traders said.

New composites fell 0.95 at 379.90, KBT value lines lost 2.00 at 651.60, Nikkei 225s were down 580.0 at 21,195, and Nasdaq 100s lost 12.85 at 752.75. -Derivative desk 312-408-8750;E-mail derivatives@reuters.com
